english.title: Fraudulently loan a vehicle licence / trade licence / registration mark / registration document
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) fraudulently lent to another a

(A)_[vehicle licence,]_
(B)_[trade licence,]_
(C)_[licence issued in respect of an exempt vehicle under paragraph 19 of schedule 2,]_
(D)_[registration mark,]_
(E)_[registration document,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 44(1) and (3) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
fraudulently lent to another a vehicle licence / trade licence /
licence issued in respect of an exempt vehicle/registration mark/document

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: IMPORTANT NOTE - As of 1st October 2014, this offence document and CJS code should no longer be used. The replacement code is VE94159.
